description: The Highlight Reel of some of my failed prints.

banner.text: Export Gerber files and have PCB manufactured.

body: I finally got a decent transparent print after a few failures.
I did a bit of post processing on half of this failed print as another print was going. Honestly, i think it turned out pretty well for how little i did do to it.
Here you can see the issue i was having with the prints. one side would detach from the build plate and try to keep going.
This is the orientation that the shell is being printed at.
This is a look inside of the resin tray while its printing.
I finished a transparent print. Did a little bit of post processing to it. I did 2 passes of sanding, one at 400 grit and than a second at 600 grit. I finished with a clear coat from a rattle can.
I used water instead of rubbing alchohol and left spots on the print. I however still like the way it turned out.
A quick look at the part in the slicer software.
A side by side of FDM print versions.
The white one is an FDM print, the black one a MSLA print.
Having an issue with warping during print.
A couple of parts with post processing done. One is an FDM print, the other MSLA.
First images of the heart of the controller. PCBWay.com sent me the completed parts images for approval.
